vaultDesc: Upload your audit certificates once and share them instantly across all your brand clients.
ndaDesc: Proprietary formulas, pricing and margins remain strictly confidential. Only proof hashes and mass-balance reconciliation are shared.
ui_pour_connecter_clerk_et_les_apis_t: to connect Clerk and the Tracefab APIs.
ui_collez_votre_nomenclature_matiere: Paste your textile material bill of materials or drop your table (semicolon or comma separator).
ui_contenu_csv_texte_copie_depuis_exc: CSV content / Text copied from Excel *
ui_enregistrer_automatiquement_les_co: Automatically save components to my material catalogue
ui_verifiez_clerk_et_la_configuration: Check Clerk and the API configuration, or open
ui_chargement_du_profil_fournisseur_e: Loading the supplier profile and data requests.
ui_completez_votre_profil_repondez_au: Complete your profile, answer requests from your client brands and keep the history of your answers.
ui_presentez_vos_capacites_industriel: Present your industrial capabilities, certifications and textile specialities…
ui_raison_sociale_ou_activites_a_rens: legal name or activities to complete
ui_raison_sociale_activites_et_capaci: Legal name, activities and industrial capabilities.
ui_fibres_fils_et_tissus_que_vous_fou: Fibres, yarns and fabrics you supply.
ui_les_donnees_produit_sont_saisies_i: Product data is entered here, then reused in your answers.
ui_scopes_echeances_et_verification_a: Scopes, expiry dates and automatic verification.
ui_demandes_versionnees_de_vos_marque: Versioned requests from your client brands.
ui_publie_la_version_courante_de_votr: Publishes the current version of your profile to your clients.
ui_coffre_fort_fournisseur_mutualise: SHARED SUPPLIER VAULT · EU TRADE SECRET DIRECTIVE
ui_deposez_votre_nomenclature_pour_va: Submit your bill of materials to automatically validate the 100% breakdown and the mass balance.
ui_les_demandes_envoyees_par_vos_marq: Requests sent by your brands will appear here.
ui_repondez_item_par_item_sauvegardez: Answer item by item, save your versioned answers then submit the request to the brand.
ui_ces_informations_sont_modifiables: This information can be edited by your organisation. A change after submission may put the profile back in progress.
ui_les_preuves_documentaires_disposen: Documentary evidence has a dedicated private space. Do not attach a secret or sensitive document in a text field; use the Evidence tab.
ui_certaines_donnees_secondaires_n_on: Some secondary data could not be loaded. You can refresh the page without losing information already saved.
ui_declarez_les_sites_actifs_et_leurs: Declare active sites and their activities. This information feeds profile completeness, without constituting a verification.
ui_ajoutez_le_premier_site_de_product: Add your organisation's first production site.
ui_les_coordonnees_gps_sont_disponibl: GPS coordinates are available via the API, but the minimal interface does not require them.
ui_declarez_vos_standards_et_dates_de: Declare your standards and validity dates. The presence of a certificate does not mean it is verified.
ui_declarez_vos_standards_et_associez: Declare your standards and attach available evidence where required.
ui_collez_le_texte_issu_de_l_ocr_du_c: Paste the text from the certificate OCR. Extraction is a data-entry aid: it neither declares nor verifies anything.
ui_collez_ici_le_texte_reconnu_sur_le: Paste here the text recognised on the certificate (number, standard, issuer, dates…)
ui_recopiez_les_champs_utiles_dans_le: Copy the useful fields into the form above: extraction does not save them.
ui_aucun_champ_reconnu_dans_ce_texte: No field recognised in this text.
ui_champs_extraits_rien_n_a_ete_enreg: Fields extracted. Nothing has been saved.
ui_maintenez_les_materiaux_dont_votre: Maintain the materials your organisation owns. Materials shared by a brand remain readable according to permissions.
ui_ajoutez_vos_premiers_materiaux_dec: Add your first declared materials or import a CSV/Excel bill of materials file.
ui_une_declaration_de_materiau_est_un: A material declaration is supplier data. It is not automatically verified.
ui_ajoutez_votre_premiere_capacite_or: Add your first capacity, origin, composition or typed operational datum.
ui_gerez_les_membres_de_l_organisatio: Manage members of the active organisation without changing tenant. Roles and suspensions are controlled server-side.
ui_ajoutez_un_collaborateur_pour_trav: Add a collaborator to work together on supplier data.
ui_seuls_les_owners_et_admins_peuvent: Only owners and admins can invite or edit a member.
ui_aucun_document_charge_un_registre: No document loaded: an empty register would wrongly claim “no evidence”.
ui_reprend_les_documents_reellement_c: Lists the documents actually loaded in the vault, column by column. No data added, no substitute value: a missing field stays empty.
ui_un_seul_televersement_associe_auto: A single upload automatically links your evidence to all requests from your client brands.
ui_partage_controle_par_la_relation_f: Sharing controlled by the supplier-brand relationship · created on
ui_les_preuves_restent_privees_jusqu: Evidence stays private until an authorised share is created.
ui_le_document_n_est_pas_encore_telec: The document is not downloadable yet.
ui_ajoutez_un_document_pour_l_associe: Add a document to link it later to an answer or a certificate.
ui_le_navigateur_ne_marque_jamais_un: The browser never marks a file as safe. The server checks the private object and the antivirus scanner before making it available.
ui_toutes_les_sections_partagees_y_co: All sections shared, including exact addresses.
ui_preuves_de_conformite_partagees_se: Compliance evidence shared, trade secrets masked.
ui_rien_n_est_visible_sans_accord_de: Nothing is visible without a signed non-disclosure agreement.
ui_saisissez_vos_donnees_une_fois_reu: Enter your data once, reuse it with all your clients. You choose what is disclosed.
ui_les_marques_qui_veulent_consulter: Brands that want to view your passport will appear here.
ui_consultez_les_demandes_de_remediat: View remediation requests sent by your client brands.
ui_decrivez_la_correction_et_la_preuv: Describe the correction and the evidence provided.
ui_les_plans_envoyes_par_vos_marques: Plans sent by your client brands will appear here.
ui_remediation_cap_soumise_en_mode_de: CAP remediation submitted in demonstration mode.
ui_remediation_cap_soumise_a_la_marqu: CAP remediation submitted to the brand.
ui_le_score_explique_la_preparation_d: The score explains supplier data readiness. It is neither a certification nor a verification.
ui_aucun_champ_manquant_signale_par_l: No missing field reported by the last calculation.
ui_calculez_un_score_pour_obtenir_une: Calculate a score to get a first explainable reading.
ui_upload_de_preuve_disponible_dans_u: Evidence upload available in an upcoming release.
ui_chaque_enregistrement_cree_une_nou: Each save creates a new answer version.
ui_preuve_associee_optionnelle_tant_q: Associated evidence (optional until the brand requires it)
ui_la_demande_n_est_peut_etre_pas_enc: The request may not have been prepared by the brand yet.
ui_une_reponse_declaree_n_est_pas_aut: A declared answer is not automatically verified. The brand may review it and request a correction.
ui_profil_soumis_a_votre_organisation: Profile submitted to your client organisation.
ui_le_code_pays_doit_comporter_2_lett: The country code must have 2 letters (e.g. PT, FR).
ui_espace_fournisseur_cree_en_mode_de: Supplier workspace created in demonstration mode.
ui_verification_automatique_simulee_e: Automatic verification simulated in demonstration mode.
ui_analyse_antivirus_simulee_en_mode: Antivirus scan simulated in demonstration mode.
ui_telechargement_temporaire_simule_e: Temporary download simulated in demonstration mode.
ui_nouvelle_version_creee_en_mode_dem: New version created in demonstration mode.
ui_acces_membre_mis_a_jour_en_mode_de: Member access updated in demonstration mode.
ui_score_qualite_recalcule_en_mode_de: Quality score recalculated in demonstration mode.
ui_veuillez_coller_le_contenu_de_la_n: Please paste the CSV bill of materials content.
ui_importation_bom_reussie_en_mode_de: BOM import successful in demo mode: 2 components added to the catalogue.
ui_erreur_lors_de_l_importation_de_la: Error while importing the bill of materials
ui_erreur_le_tableau_doit_contenir_au: Error: the table must contain at least one header row and one material.
ui_reglages_du_passeport_enregistres: Passport settings saved in demonstration mode.
ui_certificat_de_transaction_declare: Transaction certificate declared in demonstration mode.
ui_ex_nhan_textile_lda_ou_tissages_du: e.g. Nhãn Textile Lda or Tissages du Nord SAS
ui_invitation_creee_token: Invitation created. Token to be shared once only: {token}
ui_invitation_renvoyee_token: Invitation resent. Token to be shared once only: {token}
ui_nomenclature_validee: Bill of materials validated at 100%: {rows} material(s) processed and {saved} saved.
ui_aucune_organisation_fournisseur_n: No supplier organisation is linked to your account yet. Set up your company to start declaring your capabilities and sites and answering requests from your partner brands.
ui_televersez_vos_certificats_et_site: Upload your certificates and production sites once into your encrypted vault. Share compliance evidence instantly without revealing your prices, exclusive subcontractors or margins.
ui_le_catalogue_versionne_aide_a_sele: The versioned catalogue helps you select a standard and its reference version. Available evidence is checked server-side before being linked to the certificate; a declaration remains distinct from a verification or a certification.
ui_declarez_des_faits_fournisseur_ou: Declare supplier or site facts with a typed value, a validity period and available evidence. Declared or documented data never constitutes a verification.
ui_le_serveur_calcule_l_etat_document: The server computes the documented status only when private evidence already available is linked. The browser cannot enforce a verification status.
